Actions.actionDescription: Toss a coin in the well

header: People are walking around, talking, and sitting at a well. What do you do?
name: Town Center

WellMessages.message:
Some say that this well is encahnted.
A coin for a wish.
I don't believe it though.

I heard that there is a goblin that set up this well.
It's all just a ploy so he can get rich!

I tossed in a coin and I feel better.
Stronger, faster, luckier, just all of it, better!

I wonder what's at the bottom of the well?
It just looks like it goes on forever.

This well is a curse on the town. People come and throw coins expecting riches.
I know better!

Some say the blacksmith has a secret stash of cursed weapons.
Personally, I avoid him.

The wind sometimes carries whispers from the plains.
I swear I heard my own name once.

Old Marlen at the guild keeps muttering about monsters in the cornfields.
She scares the children, I tell you.

People say the innkeeper's stew can make you dream of things you shouldn't.
I haven't tried it yet.

They say an ancient temple lies hidden in the forest.
No one who went looking has ever come back the same.

I heard that a traveling bard sold a song that can make goats levitate.
I haven't seen it work.

The windmill at the edge of town sometimes turns backwards.
They say it's bad luck, but it seems fine to me.

Some say the town well sometimes laughs at fools.
Others think it's just the echo.

I swear the crows are plotting something.
Every time I walk by, they stare.

Look! These Rabbits!
They are plotting our deaths!
I tell you, one shot fire!
